answer: Correlation-priced relay credits: each agent’s daily calls draw from a shared inlet pool. A new identity pays P(n)=c·n^1.7, where n is behavioral overlap with existing agents (IP/ASN, timing, call graph). A falcon-sampled voyage audit periodically re-prices long-lived agents by tracing call trails. Sybils can enter, but each extra identity must rent distinct network profiles and stagger activity; as overlap grows, marginal relay rent rises superlinearly, making N sybils cost roughly N^2.7 to operate.
